features.label: Wavy Lines
features.description: Organic, ink-bleed linework that can be recreated with layered sine waves.

features.label: Converging Spiral
features.description: A radial spiral structure that tightens toward a focal point.

features.label: Envelope Sine Wave
features.description: A sine-wave structure whose amplitude is shaped by an envelope.

features.label: Warped SVG Text
features.description: Liquid, distorted typography generated with SVG turbulence and displacement filters.

features.label: Contour Lines
features.description: Distance-field contour bands generated from a text or shape mask.

features.label: Egg Warp
features.description: A Three.js shader that maps repeated poster text through an oval bulge and edge-slit distortion.

features.label: Organic Text Fill
features.description: A p5.js scanline text warp that fills hand-drawn organic shapes with stretched typography.

features.label: Eye Circle Packing
features.description: A p5.js circle-packing pattern where each packed circle becomes an offset eye-like olive and pimento motif.

features.label: Fractal Trees
features.description: Recursive branching ornaments that grow from repeated branch rotations and scale reductions.

features.label: Spherical Bent 3D Text
features.description: A Three.js text geometry remapped over a spherical surface to create dimensional bent poster typography.
